purpose: Rank public NeuRosetta/GeoJax revision candidates and plausible execution parameters for the December 2025 Point_data artifact without falsely claiming historical producer recovery.

basis: It is the latest public GeoJax commit before the Point_data artifact boundary.
The public GeoJax history shows no later commits before 2026-01-16.
The paper's contemporaneous 2025-12-10 Random_bifurcations history imports GeoJax as gj and directly uses gj.cross/gj.angle/gj.normalize while reading Point_data-derived PCA columns.

GeoJax/alignment.py has the same blob SHA 53560fd7de0463a51e1283b4a9c0e0db5bb33e8e at both 2025-04-23 v0.2 and 2025-05-02, so the robust PCA implementation was unchanged through the pre-artifact head.
GeoJax/angles.py at the pre-artifact head has the Apr-30 signed-angle arctan2 implementation, which is later consistent with the contemporaneous paper's angle consumers.

public_api_narrowing.finding: Legacy Neurosetta commit b32a340a96d71b97ff094d13f95904c5b2646a8d (2025-06-24) says it updated bifurcation angles for a newer GeoJax and changes calls from normalise/perpendicular to normalize/cross.
public_api_narrowing.implication: This places the compatible GeoJax API at or after public commit f44d45295a27edc4cd5154d1df2318b66de324eb, where the public GeoJax code had normalize/cross. The public GeoJax history then shows 33b0f8727ab447eff86e35a69c60c1f33b4d1513 on 2025-05-02 as the last public commit before the December artifact.
public_api_narrowing.caveat: The June wording does not prove which exact GeoJax SHA was installed; the developer may have been using a local checkout, an unpushed revision, or a package state not preserved in public Git.

geo_jax_dependency_present_by.message: Branching Angles; Also now has GeoJax as a dependency

subtree_fix.significance: optimal_partition_root maps the winning simplified-root coordinate back to the full graph using nearest_vertex

current_neurosetta.conclusion: The currently public implementation that exposes coordinate_pca is not a direct public December-2025 match to the recorded neurosetta/Python 3.10.17 runtime.

pca.center: likely mean-centering at the geometry/PCA boundary; exact historical call remains unresolved

robust_covariance_m_estimator.status: directly observed in public GeoJax pre-artifact code; exact historical invocation remains unresolved

signed_angle.method: project vectors to plane and use atan2(y,x)
signed_angle.status: directly observed in GeoJax pre-artifact code; exact historical call remains unresolved

morphology_io_and_subtree.likely_units: raw morphology coordinates preserved at import, with explicit unit conversion separate from import
morphology_io_and_subtree.likely_root_selection: automated subtree/root selection consistent with legacy Neurosetta capability
morphology_io_and_subtree.manual_root_correction: possible/likely from published method, but not recoverable from public December artifact boundary
morphology_io_and_subtree.post_selection_manual_review: possible/likely from published method, but not recoverable

decisive_unresolved_items: Exact GeoJax installation source and whether it resolved to public HEAD 33b0f872... or a local/private checkout.
Exact producer notebook/script that created Data/Point_data.pkl.
Exact input T45 morphology materialization and per-neuron manual corrections.
Exact parameter values passed to subtree selection, PCA, alignment, scaling, and metric generation.
Execution receipt binding all of the above to the exact Point_data SHA-256.
next_high_value_test: Use the later public Metrics1_Point_data algorithm plus the pre-artifact GeoJax parameter semantics to attempt value-level reproduction on any recovered historical morphology/intermediate; treat a value match as computation-path evidence, not producer identity.

decisions.details: Public Metrics1_Point_data.ipynb at commit 3a1aa1a... contains a 23-column per-tree function and no persistence call; historical Point_data has 24 columns including Subtype_evDir_x/y/z. Indexed public code search returned zero hits for evDir/Subtype_evDir/to_pickle.
decisions.impact: Do not label the public Metrics1 notebook as the exact historical Point_data producer.
